nom: Clarins Hydrating Toning Lotion with Aloe Vera

avis.titre: This is incredible! Save your empty bottles....
avis.texte: This was the 1st Clarins product that I tried & it was so good that it sent me on a quest to try their other products. Excellent quality & mostly naturally sourced ingredients. You can put a little on a cotton round, or right on your hands & gently pat it on. Rub any excess into your hands for added softness there too! It evens my skin tone, tightens & brightens plus adds the much needed moisture. It even helped clear years old whiteheads & my skin has never felt better! I use a full routine of Clarins products now. Boy have I seen amazing results in a short period of time on this aged, damaged & scarred skin! For added savings, they also sell refill pouches & pods for several of the toners, cleansers, creams & moisturizers so keep your bottles! I highly recommend this toner, as well as all of their other products. Just make sure you buy the type that is right for your skin, ie: normal, oily, dry. Buying a product from any brand that is too heavy can cause breakouts on oily & acne prone skin.
